title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Join our payments team building the Go services that process millions of transactions daily. You'll design REST APIs, write database migrations, and work on distributed systems with senior engineers.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Build user-facing features in React and TypeScript for our web dashboard. You'll work closely with designers to implement pixel-perfect, accessible UI components and improve page load performance.

title: Full Stack Software Engineering Intern
description: Work across our Next.js frontend and Node.js backend, shipping complete features end to end — from database schema to the UI that renders it.

title: Mobile Engineering Intern (iOS)
description: Build features in our Swift/SwiftUI iOS app used by millions of riders. You'll work on real-time location tracking, push notifications, and offline-first data sync.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: Train and deploy ranking models for our recommendation system. Experience with PyTorch, feature engineering, and offline evaluation metrics required.

title: Applied Research Intern, ML
description: Work with our research team on novel transformer architectures for long-context retrieval, publishing findings and prototyping in JAX.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Build and maintain our Airflow pipelines that move billions of events through Kafka into our data warehouse, ensuring data quality and freshness for analytics.

title: Infrastructure Engineering Intern
description: Help operate our Kubernetes clusters and Terraform-managed cloud infrastructure across AWS regions, improving deployment reliability and cost efficiency.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Intern
description: Own on-call rotations, write runbooks, and build alerting for our production services. You'll investigate incidents and drive postmortems to improve system reliability.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Build and improve our CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Jenkins, automating deployments and reducing build times across a dozen microservices.

title: Platform Engineering Intern
description: Build internal developer tooling and self-service infrastructure APIs that other engineering teams use to provision databases and services.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Intern
description: Design and provision multi-region AWS infrastructure using Terraform and CloudFormation, focused on cost optimization and high availability.

title: Systems Software Engineering Intern
description: Work on our low-level storage engine written in Rust, optimizing disk I/O paths and memory allocation for our distributed database.

title: Application Security Intern
description: Perform code reviews for security vulnerabilities, run penetration tests against our web applications, and help build automated SAST tooling.

title: Embedded Software Intern
description: Write firmware in C for our IoT sensor devices, working close to the hardware to optimize power consumption and real-time data collection.

title: QA Automation Engineering Intern
description: Build and maintain our Selenium/Playwright end-to-end test suites, triage flaky tests, and improve CI test reliability across the web app.

title: Developer Advocate Intern
description: Write technical tutorials and sample code demonstrating our GraphQL API, build demo applications, and speak at developer meetups about integration patterns. You will also contribute directly to our public SDKs.

title: Developer Experience Intern
description: Build and maintain our public SDKs and CLI tooling used by thousands of external developers, and improve our API documentation infrastructure.

title: Solutions Engineering Intern
description: Work directly with enterprise customers to design and implement custom integrations with our platform's API, writing production code for each deployment.

title: Marketing Intern
description: Support our social media campaigns, write blog posts about company news, and help organize community events. No coding involved.

title: Sales Development Representative Intern
description: Qualify inbound leads, schedule demos for the sales team, and update our CRM with prospect information. Great opportunity to learn B2B sales.

title: Community Manager Intern
description: Moderate our Discord and forums, organize community AMAs, and write a weekly newsletter — no technical work, purely community engagement.
